2. Installation ¢ Avoid rough handling in transportation; the picture tube is fragile. e This machine is designed for “indoor” use. So install the machine indoors only. e Install the machine on flat-surfaced floor (made of concrete, etc.) and provide suitable space around it. Do not install the machine in locations with vibrations. ° Do not install the machine in locations exposed to sunlight or excessive heat to avoid the environmental temperature rise. Also, do not install the machine at places where it is humid and/or dusty. e Do not install the machine in dangerous places in view of disaster prevention, five alarm equipment, etc. e Never fail to connect the "ground terminal” of the machine and the "ground line” of the porer supply cord. ¢ Before turning on the power switch! The screws for fastening the parts may be loosened by vibrations, etc. in transpotation. Make certain that the PC board is correctly attached and the connectors are perfectly plugged. e Plug the power cord plug into the outlet and turn on the power switch. Before this, make sure the power supply and the current capacity. e In case that any malfunction occures after turning on the power: First, turn off the power switch, and check the power supply and each output by referring the handling care. This machine does not work normally unless the proper power supply voltage is supplied.

Handling Care e This game uses microprocessors and other ICs for long stable performance life, however, as with sophisticated electronic equipment, certain precaution must be observed to avoid damage. + Do not attempt to service with ordinaly testing equipment, since the internal voltage of testing equipment may cause damage to the circuitry. + Never connect or disconnect any of connectors of the PCB set when the power is on. eAs higher voltages exist in the video monitor, extra care must be taken when inspecting and adjusting the video monitor. ¢ Do not use fuses with other current capacity than specified. If the fuses with the specified current capacity are blown, check the power unit. (Inside of Cabinet] (Outside of Cabinet] Switching Regulator Connector Box Main Fuse 5A 3A 5A Maintenance e Although this machine has been designed basing on the good safety standards, sowe trouble may occure in a long period. Therfore, it is necessary for the machine owner and operation manager to take daily checking to make sure that the safety condition of the machine is well kept.

( Selection of Airports ) eo After taking off, ‘the screen changes to the landing-selection scene. + Airports can be selected according to their weather conditions. + By turning the joystick right or left to move the biue-blashing cursor onto a desired airport for landing, and select it by pressing the start button. ( Name of Airports ) Tokyo , Fukuoka , Sydney , Rio de Janeiro , Osaka , Paris , San Francisco , and Washington D.C. ( Landing Scenes ) e The landing method of this game is the same way as that of the “Midnight Landing”. @ By using the joystick and the throttle lever, nose down to go to the airstrip on which red calling-on lamps light, and lower the altitude of the plane by adjusting the power. @ Just before landing, nose up slightly, and lower the power. (Approaching speed: 250 kt or less) 12

@ When the plane lands safely on the airstrip, a reverse-jet is produced automatically to stop the plane. The word of "LANDING" is displayed on the screen. « Score-decreasing items in landing: (The scoring system is a low-point method of scoring in which these score-decreasing item points are deducted from the basis of 100 points.) + If the plane goes up or down in a furry. + If the plane fishtails (or zigzags). + If the approaching speed is too fast. + If the plane does not move up when approaching into the airstrip. + If the plane lands on a place which is far away from the correct part of the airstrip. ( Game-over ) ¢ Game ends when the plane failed in landing. The failures of landing are: "COURS OUT” ...... When the plane is far away from the course. “CRASH” ... . When the plane comes to the ground. “OVER RUN” When the plane overruns the airstrip. e After clearing all rounds, the ending mode is displayed, then the game ends. 13
